newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra to invest A$13 mln in MFP project.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra to invest A$13 mln in MFP project.

text.p: Australian government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corporation said on Tuesday it would invest A$13 million in the MFP Development Corporation's Mawson Lakes smart city project in Adelaide.

Telstra said in a statement Mawson Lakes would trial advanced applications, services and technologies across a range of sectors such as education, health care, community linkages, energy management, home automation and electronic commerce.

"We see Mawson Lakes as being like 'a laboratory without walls' which Telstra can use to test the leading edge of our future technologies and services," Telstra group managing director, business and international, Charlie Zoi said.

The Mawson Lakes development is expected to provide residential accommodation for around 10,000 people over the next ten years, as part of the long-running Multi-Function Polis (MFP) hi-tech city project.
Zoi said while it saw Mawson Lakes and its residents as key customers, it viewed the entire project as a partnership between it and the South Australian government.
